name: serpapi_google_news_light
description: Search recent Google News quickly through SerpApi's lightweight structured engine. Use for 'latest news about...', 'Google News for...', 'recent headlines on...', 'news coverage of...', or fast topic-specific news discovery. Returns ranked articles with exact URLs, sources, dates, snippets, thumbnails, optional grouped Top Stories, localization, safety controls, and pagination for follow-up research or workflows. It searches a supplied topic; use serpapi_google_trending_now to discover seedless current trends, serpapi_google_trends for interest analysis, and MCP Fetch or crawl_url to read a selected article.

query.description: Required topic or Google-style news query. Supports operators such as site:, inurl:, and intitle:.

location.description: Optional city-level origin such as Austin, Texas, United States. Cannot be combined with uule.

uule.description: Advanced Google-encoded location. Cannot be combined with location; coordinates-based values should also supply a matching country.

country.description: Optional two-letter Google country code such as us, uk, or fr.

language.description: Optional two-letter interface language such as en, es, or fr.

language_restrict.description: Optional result-language restriction such as lang_en or lang_fr|lang_de.

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.com or google.co.uk. Default google.com.

exclude_autocorrected.description: Request exclusion of results derived from an auto-corrected spelling. Default false; Google may still correct when no alternatives exist.

filter_similar.description: Filter similar or omitted results. Default true.

start.description: Result offset for pagination. Use next_start from a prior response. Default 0.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized news results to return. Default 10.

max_top_story_groups.description: Maximum grouped Top Stories sections to retain. Default 5.

max_stories_per_group.description: Maximum articles retained inside each Top Stories group. Default 5.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi's one-hour exact-parameter cache. Default false; cached searches are free.

extra_params.description: Advanced non-reserved Google News Light parameters passed through to SerpApi. Core query, location, localization, filtering, device, pagination, cache, and output controls cannot be overridden.

include_raw.description: Include the full SerpApi JSON response for debugging. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
